question: X bought a dozen pencils for a total of Rs. 60 and 20 pens for Rs. 200. Find the total average cost of the stationery X bought.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total items bought = 12 (pencils) + 20 (pens) = 32 items.

Total cost incurred = 60 + 200 = Rs. 260.

Average cost = Total Cost ÷ Total Items.

Average cost = 260 ÷ 32 = 8.125.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 8.125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quantity of pencils = 1 dozen = 12

Total cost of 12 pencils = Rs. 60

Quantity of pens = 20

Total cost of 20 pens = Rs. 200
